chapter: Hartwick and the CBS staff years
title: The Today Show at NBC
summary: Jones played a few times on the Today Show with a small group, before CBS.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: That was NBC. I did that as a gas on a small group with Mandel Lowell sometimes. There was also George Duvivier and Dave Garroway. One Dave Garroway used do the show, I did it a couple times. I did it one time after Dave left. But, that was with NBC. That was actually before I started work at CBS. Unknown: Excuse me, Mr. Jones. I hear an alarm clock or something like that. Do you hear that?
